regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. He will surely bless you as often as with becoming reverence you read from the follow- ing pages. Why? Because this Book treats of God's own Blessed Mother Mary - our Heavenly Mother. And there is no one else on earth or in Heaven that God Himself loves as He loves the same His Ever Virgin Immaculate Mother - and wishes Her to be known and loved. Queen of the Universe.
